# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Age:** advanced in years  <sub>[v2 c3 P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000), [v2 c3 P21](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0021)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** married  <sub>[v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c25 P13](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** farmer  <sub>[v1 c16 P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Pettifer is a short, heavy-set man with a bald head, except for a small strip of hair around his ears. He has a round, red face and bulging blue eyes. When enraged, his face turns a violet hue.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c3 P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000)_

## Personality

Regarded as an eccentric crank by Brierley locals, he is notoriously candid, blunt, and short-tempered. He prides himself on speaking his mind openly, regardless of who might be offended. Despite his rough, crusty exterior and stingy reputation, he possesses a good-natured, sympathetic heart and a quiet sense of humor.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c3 P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)_

## Traits

- Candid and outspoken  <sub>[v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025)</sub>
- Short-tempered  <sub>[v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022)</sub>
- Sensitive about his baldness  <sub>[v2 c1 P22](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0022)</sub>
- Stingy  <sub>[v2 c1 P7](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0007)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and harvesting  <sub>[v1 c16 P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014), [v2 c6 P7](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0007)</sub>
- Tea-making  <sub>[v2 c3 P34](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0034)</sub>

## Goals

- To live quietly and keep his farm produce safe from trespassing livestock  <sub>[v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015)</sub>
- To maintain peace and order in his home after his wife returns  <sub>[v2 c25 P1](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0001), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>

## History

Mr. J. A. Pettifer moved to Brierley from Scottsford, New Brunswick, buying the former Robert Bell farm next to Grey Shutters. His unusual housekeeping habits, lack of fixed mealtimes, and possession of a profane parrot named Nutmeg earned him a reputation as an eccentric crank. When a neighbor's Jersey cow repeatedly trespassed into his oats, he confronted Nell Harcourt in a rage. Nell mistakenly sold his cow to a buyer, but she apologized and offered her own cow in trade, which led to the two becoming firm friends. Eventually, his estranged wife, Emily, tracked him down after reading a newspaper item and reunited with him, restoring immaculate order to his house. Though Nutmeg was killed during a severe thunderstorm, Mr. Pettifer remained content with his home life and continued as an active, supportive neighbor in the community.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c2 P21](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0021), [v2 c2 P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c24 P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 c25 P0](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0000), [v2 c25 P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058)_

## Background by volume

- Hailed originally from Scottsford, New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- Lived with his sister until her death, after which he married Emily Scott  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- Separated from his wife over domestic disputes and her dislike of his parrot, Nutmeg  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058)</sub>
- Purchased Robert Bell's farm in Brierley and moved there as a self-proclaimed bachelor  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P51](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0051)</sub>
